description: Forward-only month-end record store. No retroactive reconstruction is admitted.

rules.nikkei100Selection: Nikkei 100 = top 100 Nikkei 225 constituents by float-adjusted market cap at each snapshot
rules.countryNormalization: Normalize float-adjusted market cap separately inside JP and US, then scale each country bucket to 50%
rules.recordPolicy: Only targets archived live at the time are eligible for later realized-return evaluation.

dataCaveat: The live snapshot uses contemporaneous free-float proxies available at snapshot time. Pre-v4 records use a different strategy definition and are excluded.

nasdaq100Source.method: public NDX history + official 2026 Nasdaq changes; primary failed: 403 Client Error: Forbidden for url: https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/global-indexes/nasdaq-100-index
